task_description: Write a method in Dafny to reverse only the vowels of a given string (where y is not a vowel).
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ReverseVowels(s: string) returns (v: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned string has the same length as the input string
- The positions of non-vowel characters in the input string remain unchanged in the output
- The vowels in the input string are reversed in order within the string, while all other characters stay in their original positions
